name: same_name legal suffixes and case ignored
spec_quote: true when the two company keys (lower-case, legal suffixes removed, punctuation → space, spaces collapsed) are equal

name: same_name equal after stripping non-alphanumerics
spec_quote: or equal after removing every non-alphanumeric character ("Rosfensev" = "Rosfensev")

name: same_name empty name never matches
spec_quote: An empty name (nothing left after cleaning) is never the same as anything.

name: same_name extra non-suffix word breaks equality
spec_quote: true when the two company keys (lower-case, legal suffixes removed, punctuation → space, spaces collapsed) are equal, or equal after removing every non-alphanumeric character

name: pick_lookup keeps only matching name and lower-cases domain
spec_quote: Returns the domains (lower-case, no duplicates, original order) of the suggestions whose name is same_name as the company. "Qorvo Power" is not "Qorvo, Inc."; "Qorvo" is.

name: pick_lookup ignores non-objects and items without domain
spec_quote: Items that are not objects or have no domain are ignored.

name: pick_lookup dedupes preserving original order
spec_quote: Returns the domains (lower-case, no duplicates, original order) of the suggestions whose name is same_name as the company.

name: pick_lookup Qorvo Power does not match Qorvo Inc
spec_quote: "Qorvo Power" is not "Qorvo, Inc."; "Qorvo" is.

name: borrow_domains reduces subdomain to registrable domain
spec_quote: Reduce each host to its registrable domain: the last two labels ("careers.acme.com" → "acme.com")

name: borrow_domains skips aggregator and ats hosts
spec_quote: skip hosts that contain any of: jobright, joinhandshake, linkedin, builtin, indeed, glassdoor, greenhouse.io, lever.co, ...

name: borrow_domains three-label co.uk domain
spec_quote: or the last three when the second-to-last label is co / com / org / ac ("jobs.acme.co.uk" → "acme.co.uk")

name: borrow_domains dedupe and first-seen order
spec_quote: Return them without duplicates in first-seen order.

name: borrow_domains skips non-matching company rows
spec_quote: For rows whose company is same_name, take the host of url and of ats_url

name: borrow_domains skips bit.ly and google hosts
spec_quote: skip hosts that contain any of: jobright, joinhandshake, linkedin, builtin, indeed, glassdoor, greenhouse.io, lever.co, ashbyhq, myworkday, icims, smartrecruiters, workable, github, simplify, zapply, vansh, ziprecruiter, wellfound, "google.", bit.ly.

name: script_srcs keeps same-site, drops CDN
spec_quote: kept only when their host ends with the base host's last two labels (same site; a CDN on another domain is dropped)

name: script_srcs dedupes then applies limit 4

args.page: <script src="/a.js"></script><script src="/a.js"></script><script src="/b.js"></script><script src="/c.js"></script><script src="/d.js"></script><script src="/e.js"></script>

spec_quote: no duplicates, at most limit.

name: script_srcs subdomain same-site kept, other site dropped
spec_quote: kept only when their host ends with the base host's last two labels (same site; a CDN on another domain is dropped)

name: script_srcs resolves relative src against base path
spec_quote: URLs from <script ... src="..."> in the page, resolved against base

name: sitemap_career_urls keeps career and job paths in order
spec_quote: the <loc> URLs of a sitemap that contain "career" or a path word "job"/"jobs" (case-insensitive), in order, at most limit.

name: sitemap_career_urls case-insensitive matching
spec_quote: that contain "career" or a path word "job"/"jobs" (case-insensitive), in order, at most limit.

name: sitemap_career_urls caps at limit 4 in order
spec_quote: in order, at most limit.
